Definition: from a derivative of the base of G5168; an aperture, i.e. a needle's eye:--eye.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, trýpēma is the word for a needle’s eye. It appears once, in Matthew 19:24.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that trýpēma is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
